# S4.12 — SDK/embedding API full item + `serve`/`acp`/CLI surface family (C1)

**Stacked on:** `svitali/harnessharness-s4.11` (PR #74) · **Do not merge — operator-controlled**

## Summary

Completes the `hh-embed/1` embedding contract's C1 item
(`R-2.11.4` — AC-R-2.11.4-{13,15} gating) and lands the CLI's
remaining §7.1 surface verbs (`R-2.11.1` — AC-R-2.11.1-{13,15}):
`serve`, `acp`, `leaderboard *`, `profile *`, `async`/`defer`, and
the `participant` noun slice. Every verb is a client of the one
`hh-embed/1` contract through `Boundary` — no surface bypasses the
kernel, no surface carries its own ledger path or lowerer.

Requirement ids: `R-2.11.4`, `R-2.11.1`.
Gates: `AC-R-2.11.4-{13,15}`, `AC-R-2.11.1-{13,15}`,
`removability(0…3)` — all deterministic, all green.

## What changed

- **`crates/hh-embed-schema`** — additive contract members
  (`hh-embed/1` major unchanged, CC7/CC10):
  - `OpenSpec::New.notification_sink` — `{kind:"file", path}`; the
    `async`/`defer` carrier (ADR-0304 D1).
  - `OpenSessionParams.contract_json` — opaque opener-bound
    descriptor, verbatim-recorded, never interpreted (AC-15;
    ADR-0304 D2).
  - `set_coordinate` op (§7.4 §2.6) — `implemented: true`;
    `UnknownCoordinate` (code 1602, additive typed refusal).
  - `lab.assembly.compile` — `implemented: true` (closes
    **DF-S3.5-1**).
- **`crates/hh-registry`** — `model_profile`/`profile_test_report`
  opaque record kinds behind canonical envelope +
  `trust_record_ref` admission; decode arms for compiler linking
  (ADR-0304 D3).
- **`crates/hh-embed`** —
  - `set_coordinate`: registry-resolved `model` coordinate, §3.2.2
    relower (stages 3–5, `runtime_plan` identity re-checked),
    `model.surface.relowered` minted **before** the coordinate
    applies — durable-before-visible (ADR-0304 D5).
  - notification sink: kernel-validated at `open_session`;
    per-session `sink_seq` sweep of durable
    `security.permission.*`/`lifecycle.run.suspended` rows to the
    sink file — the ledger is the authority, the file a derived
    at-least-once view (ADR-0304 D1).
  - `lab_assembly_compile` over the boundary (canonical
    `CompiledBundle` record; V-1 in-record errors) and
    `lab.serve{target:<t>}` kernel-path lowering incl. the ACP
    artifact (ADR-0304 D4).
  - `RegistryProfiles`/`resolve_profile_coordinate` — the single
    `ProfileView` over `RegistryStore`; `pinned_profile_refs`
    decodes the canonical `{profile_ref:<coord>, pinned:true}`
    shape.
- **`crates/hh-acp`** — `EmbedDriver` (an `hh-embed/1` client:
  open/register/drain/describe, `over_fn` test seam) + stdio
  transport.
- **`crates/hh-cli`** — `--async`/`--defer` (→ `notification_sink`;
  `deferred` exit leaves the run live, sink = resume surface);
  `serve` (verbatim `lab.serve`); `acp` (`lab.serve{target:acp}`
  artifact → `EmbedDriver`/stdio); `leaderboard *` (Group-L);
  `profile register|list|show|status|report` (registry ops,
  `trust_record_ref` honored); `participant register|describe|probe`
  (canonical `drive` + `--base`; `--drive` switch+positional form;
  `hosting_plane_absent` typed, never fabricated).
- **`crates/hh-mcp-lab`** — `launch.rs` adjusted for the
  `notification_sink` member.
- **Generated** — `schema/hh-embed-1.schema.json` +
  `hh-embed-client-generated/src/generated.rs` regenerated
  (drift-checked).
- **`scripts/check-removability.sh`** — new S4.12 stanza: `hh-cli` +
  `hh-acp` are edge-free upward leaf surfaces over kernel-side deps
  only.
- **Build memory** — `docs/adr/ADR-0304`, `docs/build/runs/S4.12.md`,
  BUILD_INDEX row 74, LEDGER → S4.13; **DF-S3.5-1 closed**
  (`lab.assembly.compile` over both bindings, canonical codec).

## Reviewer notes

- The `set_coordinate` event-first ordering is deliberate: the
  `model.surface.relowered` row is the authority the next model call
  reads — an interrupted relower is consistent either way.
- Profile coordinate wire shape: `{profile_ref:<coord>,
  pinned:true}` — the canonical HIR spelling (not `{profile:{…}}`).
- Merge is operator-controlled (`mergePolicy: OPERATOR`).
